Chapter 13  Enteral and Parenteral Nutrition Support 
303
Calcium, Phosphorus, and Magnesium
Calcium, phosphorus, and magnesium are cofactors for enzymes in the metabolism 
of macronutrients. When PN (or any dextrose containing IVF) is initiated, these 
three minerals may shift intra-cellularly especially in malnourished patients.
